description.short_caption: Extensive skin lesions with bullae and erythema on the arm.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the arm and elbow of a patient with multiple areas of erythema, ulceration, and bullae formation. The lesions appear to be of varying sizes, with some showing clear fluid-filled bullae and others displaying raw, denuded skin. There is evidence of tissue damage and possible exudate. The surrounding skin appears inflamed, suggesting an infectious or inflammatory process.
